verdict.rationale: Sardine documents a Case Management workspace to review alerts, conduct investigations, and resolve cases. It also offers risk-based triage that auto-clears low-risk matches and routes or escalates higher-risk ones with explainable scores, which roughly covers alert prioritization. However, all of this comes from marketing pages, and nothing explicitly describes grouping related subjects and transactions into a single investigation. Missing for 10: documented ability to link or group multiple subjects and transactions into one investigation or case, explicit analyst-controlled alert prioritization or queueing, in-depth first-party case-management docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
